Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 13/10/2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 13/10/2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Indian Institute of Technology Delhi (IIT Delhi) under the IRD unit for project-based positions in New Delhi.

faq.question: Q2. What are the posts available in IIT Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The available positions include Research Associate (II), Research Associate (I), and Jr. Project Assistant (Tech.) under the AdiVaani Project development and management scheme.

faq.question: Q3. What is the total number of vacancies released?
faq.answer: A total of 9 vacancies have been announced across various designations under the project-based recruitment notification issued by IIT Delhi.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply for these positions?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting the completed applications via email to the designated authority is 13 October 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application submission?
faq.answer: Candidates must apply through Email by downloading the prescribed form IRD/REC-4 and sending it along with necessary documents to the official email address.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary range offered for these posts?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from Rs. 29,290 to Rs. 61,000 per month plus HRA depending upon the specific post and candidate qualifications.

faq.question: Q7. What educational qualification is required for Research Associate posts?
faq.answer: Applicants must possess a Ph.D/ MD/ MS/ MDS or equivalent degree, along with relevant research, teaching, design, and development experience.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for IIT Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for applying to these project-based research and technical positions.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for the advertised posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves initial shortlisting based on qualifications followed by an online interview conducted by the selection committee.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: You can check the official IRD IIT Delhi website at ird.iitd.ac.in to download the notification PDF and the required application form.
